proposition: read_cap never overflows and exceeds_limit accepts exactly inputs at or below the configured byte limit.
non_claims: This claim does not establish allocation success, I/O liveness, or behavior of arbitrary Read implementations.
This claim does not establish every higher-level CLI input policy.
domain: Every u64 limit and every usize read length within the take(read_cap) delivery bound.
assumptions: A take(read_cap) reader does not deliver more than read_cap bytes.
trust_dependencies: CBMC solver execution and result reporting
the pinned Rust verifier toolchain and target configuration
observable: The read_cap result and exceeds_limit acceptance predicate.

bounds.read_len: all usize values constrained by read_len <= read_cap(limit)

required_covers: one byte above a zero limit is rejected
negative_controls: Mutation control: accept limit + 1 bytes or overflow read_cap at u64::MAX.
result_satisfaction: One current verified row for the registered subject with all boundary covers satisfied.
currentness_inputs: provider, solver and Rust toolchain identity
runner generation and effective verifier configuration
actual admitted merge-group and ordered member heads
transition_policy: base_and_head_remain_protected_until_an_explicit_generation-bumped replacement or recorded retirement is accepted
